2609.26629.title: PERSONAWEAVER: Controllable Diversity Beyond Conventional Archetypes in Procedural Character Generation
2609.26629.paper_summary: Procedural character generation aims to populate games, simulations, and other virtual worlds with diverse characters. Large language models (LLMs) offer a promising foundation for scaling this task. However, LLM-based procedural character generation remains at an early stage: existing methods either generate characters directly or adapt profiles retrieved from persona banks. As we show, both approaches produce behaviorally homogeneous populations: characters overwhelmingly agree with positive moral norms and respond to questions with helpful, assistant-like reactions. To mitigate this homogenization, we introduce PersonaWeaver, which disentangles world building from behavioral specification and models behavior through setting general, diverse, manually curated banks of moral positions and conversational reactions. This design allows us to test how far LLM(s) can be pushed beyond their default behavioral patterns across settings. Across ten realistic and fantastical settings and three LLM(s), PersonaWeaver produces broader moral and interactional response distributions than prior work. Its guidance also diversifies interpersonal language, response length, and sentiment. It also produces less archetypal combinations of world attributes. Code is available at https://github.com/mqraitem/PersonaWeaver.
2609.26629.paper_summary_zh: 程序化角色生成旨在為遊戲、模擬和其他虛擬世界填充多樣化的角色。大型語言模型（LLMs）為擴展這一任務提供了有前景的基礎。然而，基於LLM的程序化角色生成仍處於早期階段：現有方法要麼直接生成角色，要麼適應從角色庫檢索的資料。正如我們所展示的，這兩種方法都產生行為上同質的群體：角色壓倒性地同意積極的道德規範，並以有幫助的、類似助手的反應回答問題。為了減輕這種同質化，我們引入了PersonaWeaver，它將世界構建與行為規範分離，並通過設置一般、多樣化的手動策劃的道德立場和對話反應來建模行為。這一設計使我們能夠測試LLM在不同設置中能夠推進多遠，超越其默認行為模式。在十個現實和幻想的設置以及三個LLM中，PersonaWeaver產生的道德和互動反應分佈比以往的工作更廣泛。它的指導還使人際語言、反應長度和情感多樣化。它還產生了較少典型的世界屬性組合。代碼可在 https://github.com/mqraitem/PersonaWeaver 獲得。
